data.long_meaning: Devanshu is a Sanskrit name that translates to 'God's descent'. In Hindu mythology, it refers to the incarnation of a god on earth. This name is believed to symbolize divine grace and protection. The name Devanshu carries the meaning “God's descent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devanshu usually hope their child will grow to embody god's descent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
